subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the vicinity of Romaritime Harbor

741370101.text: "The expert panel has confirmed that the 'Violetglow Jellyfish' sold by the defendant has caused a significant negative impact on the local ecology, and seriously disrupted the normal activities of native underwater organisms."

741370102.text: "...The evidence is conclusive, and the defendant has been declared guilty of the crime of ecological destruction."

741370103.text: W—Wait... I really didn't know anything! I wasn't the one who released them!

741370104.text: "...In light of the defendant's lack of conscious criminal intent, the defendant is hereby specially permitted to make amends for their crime."

741370105.text: "If the defendant could retrieve all Violetglow Jellyfish within the designated waters within a certain time limit, certain sanctions may be waived."

741370106.text: Retrieve!? How can I possibly do that? C—Could you please reconsider? Even a bigger fine would do...

741370107.text: "...Please see the appendix for details on the time limit." ...Sir, there is no use in trying to negotiate with me. Furthermore, you are wasting your precious time trying to argue when you could be coming up with a retrieval plan instead.

741370108.text: *sigh* Those people just bought jellyfish and released them everywhere. I'm no good at swimming... How am I supposed to retrieve them... I knew I shouldn't have sold them...

741370109.text: The Gardes will continue to investigate those who released them without permission. But, in any case...

741370110.text: You were the one who bred these jellyfish, and you were the one who sold them off the record. The one who failed to remind buyers not to release them was also you.

741370111.text: Frankly speaking, this sentence is already quite generous.

741370112.text: Ugh... I should have known better. I should've signed a disclaimer when I sold the jellyfish...

741370113.text: Anyway, I hope you'll make use of this generous sentence and rectify the situation. I also hope that the next time we meet, it won't be in the Fortress of Meropide.

741370115.text: Whoa, are you alright? You look quite pale...

741370118.text: ...You guys heard all that? I'm sorry, but I don't have time to chat right now. I've got to put up a commission at the Adventurers' Guild or hire a diver...

741370119.text: ...But putting up a commission takes time, and I don't know how to hire a diver... Argh!!! Am I really going to end up at the Fortress of Meropide?

741370120.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon is smelling a business opportunity... no... an opportunity to help another person!
